name: Scenario: second local player joins
description: Loads a level, checks a simulated fire for player 1 is read by the game and joins nobody, joins a second local player on a controller with no device, waits for its bro to spawn, places it a few blocks from the idle player 1 and drives it with the game's follower bot (or holds its input off), drops it out and checks each step and that player 1 was not affected.

campaign.description: Campaign index, as go_to_level takes it

controllerId.description: Controller id the player joins on; 2 and 3 are keyboards with no keys bound

durationSec.description: Seconds the joined player is driven

driver.description: bot (the game's follower bot) or idle (input held off)

params.code: var p = HeroController.players[0]; return p != null && p.IsAliveAndSpawnedHero();
return "players " + HeroController.GetPlayersPlayingCount() + ", player 1 on controller " + HeroController.playerControllerIDs[0];

var go = GameObject.Find("ScenarioPlayerJoin");
return go == null ? "no runner" : "runner tag " + go.tag;
